label: Empty response, no determination
description: The service answers successfully and returns no cards and no coverage information. It has said nothing: this is not the same as answering that prior authorization is not required. CRD 2.0.1 does not require a response to carry coverage information.
basis: Synthetic. The coverage information follows Da Vinci CRD 2.0.1, the version this tool judges by. CRD 2.0.1 ships no model of a CDS Hooks response, so the cards and system actions around it follow CDS Hooks as this tool reads it. It has not been observed from the live service.
